title: initializationOptions.souther
description: What a client may ask of the Souther language server in the `souther` member of `initializationOptions`. A member this schema does not name is ignored, so a client may send what a later server reads. A member it names with a value it does not allow is read as absent, and the server says so in a `window/showMessage` once the client has sent `initialized`.

adequacy.description: How much of what the rows cover the server measures and reports beside each behavior. `witness` reads what the compile already ran; `all` also generates a second set of classes and runs every row again, on every save.
